symptom: IMPORT ... LINK reports success and links nothing: the progress line prints `<Assoc>: 1 storage` (or `2 storage`), the FK column stays NULL / the junction table stays empty, no error and no link count is printed. Reported on Mendix 11.14 (upstream mendixlabs/mxcli#1557).
cause: LookupAssociationInfo scanned mendixsystem$association.storage_format into a string and the link path compared it with "Column" / "Table". The column is a smallint, 1 = FK column on the owner's table, 2 = junction table, so neither branch ever matched: resolveOneLink took its junction branch, ExecuteImport's column branch left the FK out of the INSERT, and its `!= "Table"` guard skipped the junction insert.
file: sql/import_assoc.go (decodeStorageFormat, LookupAssociationInfo); sql/import.go (ExecuteImport refuses a StorageFormat other than Column/Table before writing a row); mdl/executor/cmd_import.go (reports every LINK's count, zero included); test sql/import_assoc_test.go
insight: Not an 11.14 change. psql on runtimes booted by 10.24.24, 11.12.2, 11.13.0 and 11.14.0 shows the same smallint 1/2 on all four, so LINK had never linked anything against a real database, for either storage kind, since the initial commit. The code compared against the model's enum spelling (domainmodel.StorageFormatColumn) and was never run against a booted app. One query settles it on any booted app: `select storage_format, pg_typeof(storage_format) from "mendixsystem$association"`. Two things kept it silent: an if/else over an open-ended value, where an unmatched value falls through to doing nothing, and a report that printed a link line only when linked > 0. The sql import pipeline runs end to end under modernc SQLite: ATTACH ':memory:' AS information_schema, MaxOpenConns(1), and AS on the object-sequence UPDATE aliases. That is how the regression test pins it without Postgres. Adjacent gap, not fixed here: junction column names still come from the naming convention, not from the row's parent_column_name/child_column_name. A table-stored self-association, which Mendix suffixes `id2`, therefore fails at INSERT, loudly.
